items.title: IVF Growth Engine
items.body: End-to-end acquisition system — paid, SEO, CRM and counsellor routing — that became the operating model for the entire fertility vertical. Designed an integrated system mapping campaigns straight through CRM milestones down to clinical outcomes, allowing weekly data reviews based on actual treatments instead of simple lead volume clicks.
items.details:
## The project

Connected paid acquisition with the follow-up, consultation and treatment journey across a five-centre, multi-brand healthcare remit. The broader responsibility included monthly marketing budgets above ₹10 lakh.

## My contribution

- Designed and scaled Meta and Google campaigns using intent targeting, negative-keyword frameworks, segmentation and creative testing.
- Mapped the enquiry journey to CRM stages and coordinated marketing, telecalling and centre operations.
- Reviewed acquisition cost alongside enquiry quality and progression.

## Delivery approach

Advertisement → landing page → WhatsApp or call → telecalling follow-up → consultation → treatment. Stage definitions and operating ownership made the funnel useful for decisions beyond lead volume.

## Results & project status

My resume reports 5.2× qualified lead volume, 65% lower blended CPL and 25% lower CPA over 12 months, alongside an 18-percentage-point lift in lead-to-consultation conversion and a 9-percentage-point lift in consultation-to-treatment conversion. These are reported programme outcomes; the underlying dated cohorts were not independently audited in the portfolio. Later CRM projects support this operating model and are not the sole cause of these results.

*Project record: A01 · Career Project Portfolio, page 22 · Updated 18 September 2026.*

items.body: Investigated Meta-to-Google Sheets-to-Bitrix24 sync failures, field-mapping constraints and missing records. Designed reconciliation checks and reporting requirements to improve data traceability and campaign-to-CRM visibility.
items.details:
## The project

Connected Meta enquiries, Google Sheets and Bitrix24 records while accounting for delayed imports and legitimate repeat enquiries. The work covered a desktop synchronisation loop and a separate historical relationship audit.

## My contribution

- Defined conservative matching rules and preserved each distinct Meta Lead ID instead of merging repeat enquiries solely by phone number.
- Clarified real import behaviour, supplied operating records, ran checks and directed AI-assisted implementation.
- Kept one owner for new Master rows and reviewed permitted CRM attribution updates and readback.
- Separated qualified leads, appointments, attended consultations and treatment events for reporting.

## Delivery approach

Meta source sheet → Apps Script Master record → Windows Python worker → conservative CRM matching → permitted blank-field enrichment → readback → current-status updates in Master and source sheets. The stack uses Apps Script, Python, Google Sheets, Bitrix24 APIs and SQLite.

## Results & project status

The project record documents selected successful writes/readback, correction of stale statuses and Desktop v0.3 live operation evidence in September. The separate historical audit processed 28,122 approved leads with zero reported API errors. Processing scope is not a claim of complete matching or delivered conversions. Historical completeness, sustained latency, restart recovery, Oracle migration and Meta CAPI receipt remained separate acceptance items. The supplied software screenshot records a historical worker milestone, not a current service-health check.

*Project record: A07 · Career Project Portfolio, page 28 · Updated 18 September 2026.*
